strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Build a personal weak-network VPN for OpenWrt/Linux to Linux or Windows whose steady-state path is TUN/IP -> WBD packet framing -> fixed-mode FEC -> standards-compliant DTLS 1.3 -> TCP-shaped udp2raw-compatible FakeTCP. The public carrier is not an ordinary kernel TCP byte stream. Optional TLS Persona may add a real TLS 1.3 preflight with maintained browser-like ClientHello profiles, but it remains separate from DTLS/FEC steady-state data.
strategic_horizon.current_milestone: V2-M6 Linux/OpenWrt native L3/TUN core; M4 kernel-anchor retired and M5 two-lane deferred
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Finish a complete one-lane Linux/OpenWrt packet path before optional Persona implementation, Windows optimization, two lanes or Auto. Preserve packet boundaries end-to-end; do not introduce a reliable public byte stream. Broad parameter sweeps begin only after the Linux/OpenWrt plus Windows core interoperates.
